Request changes for three defects: class merging can discard a listed blocker; invalid/all-block policy preserves explicit deferrals; default-policy launches omit the mandatory quote.
Acceptance checklist, using the supplied untraced-criteria list for STORY-b6b1278890774ef993d2ebc327862470-806 (canonical STORY-2913):
AC1 .acd80026 — free list from documented registry including p1, p2, p3, data-loss, security-authority-bypass, unmet-claimed-ac, test-gap, style; unknown classes refuse: verified by inspected CLASSES/canonical/parse_names/from_config_text, registry documentation, story_2913_registry_parses_strictly and task_3814_invalid_policy_refuses test code.
AC2 .acefe1a7 — default every finding blocks and this repository sets the operator's four classes: unverified. The config matches the ruling and task_3814_absent_preserves_p2_refusal_and_prompt covers ordinary findings, but apply_policy(AllBlock) preserves explicit deferred dispositions, including for an invalid configured list; see finding 2.
AC3 .ac0add0e — automatically file nonblocking findings as linked follow-up specs, deduplicate by finding hash, approve: verified by inspected ledger delivery barriers/filer integration and story_2913_custom_list_auto_files_followups, which asserts approval, two linked tasks and retry deduplication. Classification correctness is separately defective in finding 1.
AC4 .ac05bb6e — changing the list requires operator or mandate authority and is audited: verified by inspection of resolve_change_authority/decide_change_authority, validated advisor grant and explicit review-policy mandate scope, read-only config knob, write_list audit fields, story_2913_unauthorized_change_is_refused, story_2913_set_writes_an_audited_canonical_list and branch-local policy isolation test. This verifies the supported setter; direct committed config edits retain Git-history audit rather than an enforced setter stamp, as disclosed in the PR.
AC5 .acb249c8 — config show lists effective tier with provenance and every review prompt quotes active list: unverified. The policy_registry row and worksheet do this, with prompt assertions in task_3814_enabled_approves_p2_but_never_p1_or_exceptions; launch_prompt deliberately returns empty for all-block/default/invalid cases; see finding 3.
AC6 .Tests — tests for unchanged default behavior, custom lists blocking only their classes, automatic follow-ups and unauthorized-change refusal: unverified. The diff adds or updates named tests for all four areas, addressing the supplied previously untraced list, but omits the explicit-deferral fallback and test-gap/listed-class merge cases described in findings 1 and 2. No criterion is not applicable.
Validation limits: no Cargo, build or local test commands run, per reviewer policy. Exact-head GitHub CI fast gates passed; fast compile timed out after five minutes in Install compile dependencies, before compile/test evidence, and the aggregate Build failed. Implementer-reported targeted test successes were read as claims, not independently executed results. The installed aida binary rejects the new config spelling, so review prompt generation failed. The supplied absolute codegraph client is absent; aida doctor check codegraph supplied no useful client diagnosis. Navigation continued with rg and full source reads. No branch edits, merge or canonical verdict recording performed.
